from: Claude Code cloud session (no SAP Commerce, no provider keys, no browser)
how_to_use: Paste this file first. Then restore the code (see code_access). Then follow next_steps in order. Everything marked UNVERIFIED was written from memory and must be checked against the real platform before it is trusted.
new_chat_prompt: You are continuing the UC1 build (SAP Commerce AI-First Conversational B2B Commerce Accelerator) from a handoff. Read this JSON fully. Rules that never bend: the owner's conventions are binding (see conventions); protected decisions D01-D37 never change without owner approval; unknown conventions are asked about, never invented; AI never sees prices, margin, names, emails, internal PKs or other customers' data and has no write tool; customer identity comes only from the Spring Security context; every external model call goes through the sanitiser; no keys, real data or client-specific models in the repo; logs never contain prompts, message text or personal data. Separate facts, assumptions and recommendations in everything you write. I am on a machine that has SAP Commerce: start with next_steps item 1 and report real compile errors back instead of guessing.

product.name: UC1 SAP Commerce AI-First Conversational B2B Commerce Accelerator
product.summary: Public-repo drop-in module for a client's SAP Commerce OCC, facade and core layers plus a Spartacus lazy-loaded feature: a full-page ChatGPT/Claude-style purchasing assistant for logged-in B2B dealers. AI interprets and communicates; SAP Commerce Java is the executor of record. Excluded: promotions, AI-generated queries, AI-placed orders, separate authentication, persisted chat history, photo search, voice, human handoff.
product.assumed_versions_owner_to_confirm: SAP Commerce 2211-jdk21 (Jakarta, Spring 6), Angular 19, Node 22 (A12). Names cc/CC/cccore... derived (N1).

protected_decisions_summary: D01 public repo/no secrets; D02 local demo seeded dummy data; D03 Add to Cart = labelled placeholder list, AI never orders; D04 dealer persona; D05 search by code/description/use case/constraints; D06 deterministic backend search, AI extracts/judges, price/stock in backend; D07 session-only memory; D08 interest events in own table, on by default with notice, toggle, 90-day retention; D09 full-page + welcome panel; D10 order tracking from Commerce-held data only; D11 simple rule-based replenishment; D12 pattern change detection; D13 every capability toggleable (fail-closed for PL-01/03/04/05); D15 cross-sell deterministic, AI explains; D16 FAQ only approved content; D17 multilingual translate in/process English/translate out, identifiers never translated; D18 provider/model per task (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI); D19 keys only in secure properties; D21 comparison/compatibility; D22 reorder; D23 ten scenarios; D24 business controls, margin never to LLM/customers; D25 quantity recs/basket optimisation; D26 AI returns IDs only, backend hydrates; D27 labelled demo stock with live-stock hook; D28 off-topic redirected, unsupported declined; D29 live steps + streamed answer; D30 thumbs metadata only; D31 contact account manager text; D32 five packs, generators in repo, live switch, coexist; D33 own orders only; D34 own history only; D35 quick order, budget planner, substitution, order search, why-this, editable list; D36 <=10 s target, usage caps; D37 owner conventions binding, FUTURE SCOPE comments. Owner-approved: A1 fail-closed toggles, A2 synthetic-data-only guard, A3 NOT adopted, A4 pack dealers + all-packs dealer, A5 ROLE_CUSTOMERGROUP only with userId binding, A7 events/feedback separate tables, A9 AI suggests enum event types only, A10 margin separate item type, A11 browser-held list and context, A13 validate-then-reveal streaming, A14 audit as structured logs. Pending: N3 welcome caching (not implemented), N4 spike fallbacks changing protected decisions, N8 PwC theme (implemented as designed, flagged).

architecture.principle: Model proposes, Java validates/executes/hydrates, browser renders validated blocks.
architecture.turn_flow: UserBindingGuard -> facade validation (sample style) -> UsageCapService + PL-04 -> language detect -> TranslateStep in (protected [Pn] tokens, 1 retry) -> Sanitiser (allow-list per task, NEVER fields, masking, OutboundGuard) -> ModelRouter DECIDE -> DecisionValidator -> WorkflowTemplate (deterministic tools via ToolRegistry, parallel groups, step/time/tool-call caps) -> Composer COMPOSE/EXPLAIN (slots only {{S:name}}, no loose digits, no unknown codes, text vs table check, else fixed template) -> blocks streamed, then text_delta, then done(responseId, trace)
security_invariants_with_tests: SanitisedPayload has package-private constructor, so adapters cannot take unsanitised text
Tools take no customer argument; customer = TurnState.customerId (IsolationAndLoadTest)
Model IDs dropped unless a tool returned them this turn (ProvenanceChecker)
Audit keys whitelisted (AuditEvent.ALLOWED_KEYS); no prompts/message text

architecture.spring_naming: Own beans are ccXxx; @Resource(name="ccXxx") on own types (a plain @Resource named configurationService would clash with the platform bean). List beans: ccConfigSources, ccSanitisationRules, ccModelAdapters, ccChatTools, ccWorkflowTemplates. Gateways use alias pattern ccDefaultXGateway + alias ccXGateway for client override.

pitfalls: Do not trust any SAP import in this code until it compiles on the real platform.
Setters on engine classes exist only so tests can wire them; keep @Resource(name=...) fields as the production injection (owner convention).
Engine tests use teststubs/ (fake SystemException, ServicesUtil). Never ship teststubs.
Anthropic Fable/Mythos models are excluded from ZDR: never route ZDR clients to them; model IDs are configuration, not code.
Free-tier Gemini is for synthetic data only (A2 guard in DefaultModelRouter).

Config entries pack.

.* are read for the ACTIVE pack only; changing activePack takes effect after cache TTL plus page reload.
